app.title: Escalate
app.disclaimer: Escalate is a self-help tool, not legal advice.
app.no_cases: No cases yet. Start one on the New case page.
app.api_down: Cannot reach the Escalate API at {url}. Is it running?
app.cloud_warning: Your AI model runs in the cloud ({url}). Free cloud tiers may use what you send for training. Avoid real personal data, or switch to a local model.
app.demo_mode: Demo mode: nothing is really sent, and cases are deleted after 24 hours.
page.scam: I was scammed: do this now
scam.caption: Time matters: banks can sometimes stop a payment only in the first hours.
scam.country: Your country (ISO code, e.g. PK, IN, GB, US)
scam.generic: Generic checklist — check the rules in your country.
scam.then: When the urgent steps are done, open a case to get the letters drafted.
new.caption: Describe it in your own words: what you bought or paid for, when, how much, and what went wrong. Escalate will never ask for passwords, PINs or one-time codes.
new.country: Country (ISO code, e.g. PK, IN, GB, US)
new.working: Reading your evidence and preparing the first step…
pending.urgent: Do these now — they are time-critical
pending.urgent_done: I have done the urgent steps
pending.draft_waiting: A draft is waiting for your approval.
pending.waiting: Waiting for a reply. Log it when it arrives; the follow-up is automatic.
dash.generic: Generic international ladder — check the rules in your country.
review.none: No draft is waiting for approval in this case.
review.subject: Subject
questions.none: No questions right now. The agent has what it needs for this step.
questions.intro: The next letter needs a few details. Only write what you know for sure.
reply.not_waiting: This case is not waiting for a reply right now.
verdict.resolved: resolved — you got what you asked for
verdict.partial: partial — some of what you asked for
verdict.refused: refused — the agent will prepare the next step
settings.email_help: Set EMAIL_MODE, SMTP_USER and SMTP_APP_PASSWORD in .env (or run scripts/gmail_auth.py for Gmail API), then restart the API.
settings.ui_language_help: The interface language is chosen in the sidebar. Translations live in locales/.
dash.delete: Delete this case and all its files
dash.delete_confirm: Yes, delete everything for this case
pending.confirm_resolution: The agent thinks the company's reply resolves your case. Confirm before it closes.
